notes: The final clause repeats the verb 'dwell'; both Hebrew verbs are written, so each takes its own English and rule 22 does not reach it.
In צִפּוֹר כָּל־כָּנָף the relational 'of' goes to the rectum phrase's opening quantifier, headed on 'every' (rule 19); the resultative lamed after הָיָה is unrepresented (rules 21, 40).
